body_html:
The big American Jackpots have just been won. This weekend’s best plays are in Europe!

There are fantastic opportunities worth exploring for our lottery spend this week. We’ve seen some big jackpots taken off the board in America. Read about it all right here! 

Three Massive American Jackpots won in the past week

It’s rare to see both big American Jackpots at $20,000,000. Not that this is a small amount of money – we’re just used to seeing nine figure amounts.

The American Mega Millions Jackpot was won on Friday April 14 in New York state. On Tuesday, A single ticket matching all 5 numbers and the Mega Ball was again sold in New York, this time taking home the $20 million jackpot.

The American Powerball Jackpot was won on Wednesday. A single ticket matching all 5 numbers and the Powerball sold in Ohio claimed the $250+ jackpot.

Time will tell whether lightning strikes again!

The Luck of the Irish

The Irish Lotto now sits at €5.5 million… it’s been rolling over for eight draws presently.

Lotto Express clients love playing the Irish Lotto because of its amazing jackpot odds in relation to all other European Jackpots.

This Saturday’s jackpot is definitely worth a flutter… particularly when saving 45% off the regular price at Lotto Express when you purchase five boards.

Check it out now and get into the action!

French Lotto

Get your ticket quickly and keep watch on this jackpot as it draws three times per week – which means it can rollover three times per week!

With the jackpot this high – it’s bound to be won soon. Don’t miss out!

Good Luck everybody.
